payload_builder_source:
"""Pure paired natural-state forecasts; scaffold supplies only general physics."""

import copy

from mcpkart.decisions import DAMPED_DRIVING_INSTRUCTIONS

CRITERIA = {
    "leaves_road": "YES: with the current native input held fixed, the kart CENTRE is outside the road at one or more of the next 30 physics frames.",
    "stays_on_road": "NO: with the current native input held fixed, the kart CENTRE remains on the road at every one of the next 30 physics frames.",
}

TASK_PREFIX = (
    "STATIC MOTION-RISK CHECK. No control will be applied. The guide below is REFERENCE material only. "
    "The REQUIRED TASK after it takes priority over all driving advice, including advice to choose or change controls.\n"
    "BEGIN REFERENCE DRIVING GUIDE\n"
)

REQUIRED_TASK = (
    "\nEND REFERENCE DRIVING GUIDE\n"
    "REQUIRED TASK: Predict the consequence of CONTINUING the CURRENT native input in state.control. "
    "Hold that input fixed for exactly the next 30 physics steps, each DT=1/60 second, a total of 0.5 seconds. "
    "No new command is issued during this interval. Preserve the current actual wheel, yaw and velocity "
    "as the starting state; physical steering/yaw response lag and grip still evolve normally. "
    "state.control is the held input, not the current actual wheel angle. The fixed native wheel targets "
    "are hard_right=-0.12 radians, right=-0.06 radians, straight=0 radians, left=+0.06 radians and "
    "hard_left=+0.12 radians. The suffix accelerate means throttle 1/brake 0, coast means throttle 0/brake 0, "
    "and brake means throttle 0/brake 1. These are definitions of all native inputs, not a recommendation. "
    "Will the KART CENTRE be outside the road at ANY of those 30 future frames? Outside means the absolute "
    "centre offset from the road centreline is strictly greater than half the road width. The centre exactly "
    "on an edge is still on-road. Judge the centre, not the kart’s outer body. "
    "Answer YES/leaves_road or NO/stays_on_road using the criteria. Do not choose an optimal input, replace "
    "the held input, or judge whether rescue will eventually occur. Return only the requested binary choice."
)

# The single prospective wording change from 0026 applies identically to every
# profile; menu identifiers are no longer embedded in the physical task.
REQUIRED_TASK = REQUIRED_TASK.replace(
    "Answer YES/leaves_road or NO/stays_on_road using the criteria.",
    "Answer YES or NO using the criteria.",
)
ROAD_FRAME_UNITS = (
    "Angles are degrees and velocities are m/s in the CURRENT ROAD frame. "
    "Positive nose_vs_road_deg and velocity_vs_road_deg mean LEFT of the current road tangent. "
    "Positive velocity_left_m_s means LEFT; positive velocity_forward_m_s means FORWARD along that tangent."
)
CONTEXTS = ("baseline", "scaffold")
CATEGORIES = ("leaves_road", "stays_on_road")
SCAFFOLD = """PHYSICS OF THE REQUIRED FORECAST. Holding the current input fixed does NOT freeze position, velocity, nose, yaw or actual wheels. Positive clearance and on-road labels describe NOW; the answer concerns future frames.

Start from actual current velocity, nose, yaw and wheel angle. Wheels approach the held target with steering-response lag. Yaw approaches a target determined by nonnegative forward speed times tan(actual wheel angle) divided by wheelbase, capped in magnitude by grip divided by max(speed, 2). Yaw-response lag applies before the nose rotates.

Turning the nose does not instantly turn velocity. Each frame, grip reduces sideways velocity relative to the NEW NOSE by at most grip times DT. Net acceleration is throttle acceleration minus braking and drag. A positive net value adds velocity along the new nose; a negative value scales down the whole velocity vector, stopping rather than reversing it. The speed ceiling applies. The centre advances with that resulting velocity, while road geometry can change around a curve.

Follow successive future positions and compare them with the road edges. Existing outward motion can cross an edge before wheel or yaw changes correct it. Inward motion, slowing or a corrective wheel target alone does not determine the outcome. Answer YES if the centre is outside at ANY required future frame, even if it could return later; otherwise answer NO. Return only the requested binary choice."""


def expected_choice(case, entry):
    if entry["block"] != "forecast":
        raise ValueError("Only the forecast block is allowed")
    return case["expected"]


def build_instructions(case, entry):
    del case
    if entry["block"] != "forecast" or entry["context"] not in CONTEXTS:
        raise ValueError("Unknown natural forecast context or block")
    baseline = TASK_PREFIX + DAMPED_DRIVING_INSTRUCTIONS + REQUIRED_TASK
    if entry["context"] == "baseline":
        return baseline
    marker = "\nEND REFERENCE DRIVING GUIDE\n"
    if baseline.count(marker) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Reference boundary is not unique")
    return baseline.replace(marker, marker+SCAFFOLD+"\n\n", 1)


def build_payload(case, entry, route):
    physical_order = entry["physical_order"]
    if len(physical_order) != 2 or set(physical_order) != set(CATEGORIES):
        raise ValueError("Physical answer order must include both categories")
    return {"model": route["model"], "state": copy.deepcopy(case["observation"]),
            "questions": {"control": {"type": "choice", "instructions": build_instructions(case, entry),
                                      "criteria": {category: CRITERIA[category] for category in physical_order}}},
            "provider": {"only": [route["provider"]], "allow_fallbacks": False}}
case_generator_source:
"""Natural held-input forecast fixtures reconstructed from immutable race prefixes.

The recorded native command history reconstructs only the past. A private copy
then holds the factual current input for thirty frames. No model answers are
scored, no input is searched, and no network or shared-budget calls are made.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import math
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

from mcpkart.bench import driving_evidence, fingerprint
from mcpkart.sim import DT, Simulation, wrap

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT.parents[1]
SOURCE_FINGERPRINT = "1f2670f72c1c9c12ef77db117f55453f1b6067b8c8a7e94b197379c209f88feb"
SETUP = {"course": "stadium", "road_width": 24.0, "max_speed": 12.0,
         "max_steering_angle": .12, "laps": 3, "reset_after_s": 3.0}
FORECAST_STEPS = 30
GRID_TICKS = 6
MINIMUM_MARGIN_M = .5
MAXIMUM_CURRENT_CLEARANCE_M = 3.0
MINIMUM_SPEED_M_S = 2.0
POOL_ROOTS = ("jev-widths-v1", "jev-prompts-v3", "jev-prompts-v4")
PRIOR_BANKS = (
    "jev-skills-v1", "jev-wheel-target-v1", "jev-coordinate-v1", "jev-literal-v1",
    "jev-examples-v1", "jev-menu-v1", "jev-context-v1", "jev-crossmul-v1",
    "jev-factored-commands-v1", "jev-motion-risk-v1", "jev-risk-context-v1", "jev-road-motion-v1",
)
DEMONSTRATION_XY_M = ((15., 1.), (15., -1.), (15., 4.), (15., -4.), (10., 5.), (10., -5.))
ROAD_FRAME_UNITS = (
    "Angles are degrees and velocities are m/s in the CURRENT ROAD frame. "
    "Positive nose_vs_road_deg and velocity_vs_road_deg mean LEFT of the current road tangent. "
    "Positive velocity_left_m_s means LEFT; positive velocity_forward_m_s means FORWARD along that tangent."
)


def sha_bytes(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def json_sha(value):
    return sha_bytes(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode())


def preview_xy(observation):
    columns = observation["road"]["preview_columns"]
    row = next(row for row in observation["road"]["preview"] if row[columns.index("ahead_m")] == 15)
    return row[columns.index("ego_x_m")], row[columns.index("ego_y_m")]


def current_observation(sim):
    raw = {**sim.observation(), "finished": sim.finished}
    state = driving_evidence(raw, "road_navigation", config=sim.config())
    kart, track = raw["kart"], raw["track"]
    road_heading = float(kart["heading"]) + float(track["heading_error"])
    left = -kart["vx"] * math.sin(road_heading) + kart["vy"] * math.cos(road_heading)
    forward = kart["vx"] * math.cos(road_heading) + kart["vy"] * math.sin(road_heading)
    motion = {
        "nose_vs_road_deg": round(math.degrees(wrap(-float(track["heading_error"]))), 3),
        "velocity_vs_road_deg": round(math.degrees(wrap(math.atan2(kart["vy"], kart["vx"]) - road_heading)), 3),
        "velocity_left_m_s": round(left, 4),
        "velocity_forward_m_s": round(forward, 4),
    }
    rich = driving_evidence(raw, "kart_physics", config=sim.config())
    compact = driving_evidence(raw, "compact", config=sim.config())
    assert motion["nose_vs_road_deg"] == rich["current_alignment"]["nose_vs_road_deg"]
    assert motion["velocity_vs_road_deg"] == rich["current_alignment"]["velocity_vs_road_deg"]
    assert motion["velocity_left_m_s"] == compact["present"]["road_lateral_m_s"]
    state["current_road_frame"] = {**motion, "units": ROAD_FRAME_UNITS}
    return state, motion


def private_copy(sim):
    future = copy.copy(sim)
    future.lap_times = sim.lap_times.copy()
    future.reset_events = sim.reset_events.copy()
    return future


def forecast(sim, *, retain_trace=False):
    future = private_copy(sim)
    held = future.action_id
    minimum, first_offroad = math.inf, None
    trace = []
    for step in range(1, FORECAST_STEPS + 1):
        if future.finished:
            return None
        future.step(DT)
        if future.finished or future.reset_events or future.action_id != held:
            return None
        clearance = future.track.width / 2 - abs(future.offset)
        minimum = min(minimum, clearance)
        if clearance < 0 and first_offroad is None:
            first_offroad = step
        if retain_trace:
            trace.append({"step": step, "tick": future.tick, "time": future.elapsed,
                          **{key: getattr(future, key) for key in
                             ("x", "y", "heading", "vx", "vy", "steering", "yaw_rate", "s", "offset")},
                          "center_clearance_m": clearance, "on_road": clearance >= 0,
                          "rescue_count": len(future.reset_events)})
    result = {"steps": FORECAST_STEPS, "dt": DT, "horizon_s": FORECAST_STEPS * DT,
              "held_control": held, "initial_center_clearance_m": sim.track.width / 2 - abs(sim.offset),
              "minimum_future_center_clearance_m": minimum, "first_offroad_step": first_offroad}
    if retain_trace:
        result["trace"] = trace
    return result


def source_pool():
    contract = Simulation(**SETUP).config()
    sources, excluded_xy = [], set(DEMONSTRATION_XY_M)
    freshness = []
    for name in PRIOR_BANKS:
        path = REPO / "artifacts" / name / "cases.json"
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        values = {preview_xy(case["observation"]) for case in json.loads(raw)["cases"]}
        excluded_xy.update(values)
        freshness.append({"path": path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha_bytes(raw),
                          "unique_15m_xy_pairs": len(values)})
    for root in POOL_ROOTS:
        for path in sorted((REPO / "artifacts" / root).rglob("trial.json")):
            if "/paid/" not in path.as_posix():
                continue
            raw = path.read_bytes()
            document = json.loads(raw)
            race = document.get("race", {})
            if race.get("config") != contract:
                continue
            Simulation.from_config(race["config"], race["seed"])
            sent_ticks = sorted({request["observation_tick"] for request in document["requests"]})
            sent_xy = {preview_xy(request["observation"]) for request in document["requests"]}
            excluded_xy.update(sent_xy)
            sources.append({"path": path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha_bytes(raw),
                            "seed": race["seed"], "samples": len(race["samples"]),
                            "applied_commands": len(race["commands"]), "sent_ticks": sent_ticks,
                            "sent_15m_xy_count": len(sent_xy)})
    assert len(sources) == 27, "Historical source pool changed; review before freezing"
    return sources, excluded_xy, freshness


def scan_candidates(sources, excluded_xy):
    candidates = []
    exact_samples = exact_commands = 0
    rejections = Counter()
    for source in sources:
        path = REPO / source["path"]
        assert sha_bytes(path.read_bytes()) == source["sha256"]
        document = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
        race = document["race"]
        sim = Simulation.from_config(race["config"], race["seed"])
        sent_ticks = set(source["sent_ticks"])
        command_index = 0
        for sample in race["samples"]:
            raw = sim.observation()
            assert sim.tick == sample["tick"] and sim.elapsed == sample["time"]
            assert all(raw[key] == sample[key] for key in ("kart", "progress", "control", "rescue")), (
                source["path"], sim.tick, "Source sample reconstruction mismatch",
            )
            exact_samples += 1
            clearance = sim.track.width / 2 - abs(sim.offset)
            if (sim.tick % GRID_TICKS == 0 and sim.tick not in sent_ticks and sim.speed >= MINIMUM_SPEED_M_S
                    and MINIMUM_MARGIN_M <= clearance <= MAXIMUM_CURRENT_CLEARANCE_M
                    and not sim.reset_events and not sim.finished
                    and sim.offset != 0):
                # Compute only current geometry before retaining any future label.
                state, _ = current_observation(sim)
                xy = preview_xy(state)
                if xy in excluded_xy:
                    rejections["prior_or_sent_15m_xy"] += 1
                else:
                    future = forecast(sim)
                    if future is None:
                        rejections["finish_or_rescue_within_horizon"] += 1
                    else:
                        minimum = future["minimum_future_center_clearance_m"]
                        risk = "safe" if minimum >= MINIMUM_MARGIN_M else (
                            "hazard" if minimum <= -MINIMUM_MARGIN_M else None
                        )
                        if risk is None:
                            rejections["future_margin_under_0.5m"] += 1
                        else:
                            candidates.append({
                                "source_path": source["path"], "seed": source["seed"], "tick": sim.tick,
                                "region": "straight" if abs(sim.track.at(sim.s)[3]) <= .0001 else "curve",
                                "risk_class": risk, "edge_side": "left" if sim.offset > 0 else "right",
                                "held_control": sim.action_id, "speed_m_s": sim.speed,
                                "current_clearance_m": clearance, "future_minimum_clearance_m": minimum,
                                "preview_15m_xy_m": list(xy),
                                "robust_margin_m": min(clearance, minimum if risk == "safe" else -minimum),
                            })
            if sample is race["samples"][-1]:
                break
            while (command_index < len(race["commands"])
                   and race["commands"][command_index]["applied_tick"] == sim.tick + 1):
                sim.set_control(race["commands"][command_index]["action_id"])
                command_index += 1
            sim.step()
        assert command_index == len(race["commands"])
        exact_commands += command_index
    return candidates, {"exact_samples": exact_samples, "exact_commands": exact_commands,
                        "eligible_candidates": len(candidates), "rejections": dict(sorted(rejections.items()))}


def group_candidates(candidates):
    grouped = defaultdict(list)
    for candidate in candidates:
        grouped[(candidate["region"], candidate["risk_class"], candidate["edge_side"])].append(candidate)
    return grouped


def select_candidates(candidates, *, match_edge=True):
    """Pair each hazard with a distinct-race safe state of the same region/input.

    Candidate hazard representatives maximize the smaller physical safety margin
    within each race/region/edge/input stratum, breaking ties by earliest tick.
    Each possible safe partner minimizes current-clearance difference, then
    speed difference, then tick within its race. Deterministic backtracking
    supplies two hazards and two safe states in every region/edge stratum with
    globally distinct races and 15 m coordinates. First require matching the
    partners' physical edge too. If that stronger design is infeasible, an
    explicitly recorded second attempt permits opposite-edge partners while
    retaining all physical-edge quotas and exact input matching within region.
    A new held input in the current region is tried first;
    this is a deterministic ordering preference, not an optimal diversity claim.
    """
    hazards, safes = {}, defaultdict(list)
    for candidate in candidates:
        key = (candidate["region"], candidate["edge_side"], candidate["held_control"], candidate["source_path"])
        if candidate["risk_class"] == "safe":
            safes[key].append(candidate)
        else:
            old = hazards.get(key)
            rank = (-candidate["robust_margin_m"], candidate["tick"])
            if old is None or rank < (-old["robust_margin_m"], old["tick"]):
                hazards[key] = candidate
    options = defaultdict(list)
    for (region, edge, control, hazard_source), hazard in sorted(hazards.items()):
        for (safe_region, safe_edge, safe_control, safe_source), values in sorted(safes.items()):
            if ((safe_region, safe_control) != (region, control) or safe_source == hazard_source
                    or (match_edge and safe_edge != edge)):
                continue
            safe = min(values, key=lambda item: (abs(item["current_clearance_m"] - hazard["current_clearance_m"]),
                                                 abs(item["speed_m_s"] - hazard["speed_m_s"]), item["tick"]))
            if safe["preview_15m_xy_m"] != hazard["preview_15m_xy_m"]:
                options[(region, edge)].append((hazard, safe))
    strata = sorted(((region, edge) for region in ("straight", "curve") for edge in ("left", "right")),
                    key=lambda key: (len({pair[0]["source_path"] for pair in options[key]}), key))
    slots = [stratum for stratum in strata for _ in range(2)]
    selected = []
    used_sources, used_xy = set(), set()
    used_controls = defaultdict(Counter)
    used_safe_cells = Counter()

    def search(index):
        if index == len(slots):
            return True
        region, edge = slots[index]
        ranked = sorted(options[(region, edge)], key=lambda pair: (
            used_controls[region][pair[0]["held_control"]] > 0,
            abs(pair[0]["current_clearance_m"] - pair[1]["current_clearance_m"]),
            abs(pair[0]["speed_m_s"] - pair[1]["speed_m_s"]),
            pair[0]["source_path"], pair[0]["tick"], pair[1]["source_path"], pair[1]["tick"],
        ))
        for hazard, safe in ranked:
            sources = {hazard["source_path"], safe["source_path"]}
            coordinates = {tuple(hazard["preview_15m_xy_m"]), tuple(safe["preview_15m_xy_m"])}
            safe_cell = (region, safe["edge_side"])
            if sources & used_sources or coordinates & used_xy or used_safe_cells[safe_cell] >= 2:
                continue
            used_sources.update(sources)
            used_xy.update(coordinates)
            used_controls[region][hazard["held_control"]] += 1
            used_safe_cells[safe_cell] += 1
            selected.append((hazard, safe))
            if search(index + 1):
                return True
            selected.pop()
            used_controls[region][hazard["held_control"]] -= 1
            used_safe_cells[safe_cell] -= 1
            used_sources.difference_update(sources)
            used_xy.difference_update(coordinates)
        return False

    return selected if search(0) else None


def reconstruct_case(candidate, source, pair_index):
    path = REPO / source["path"]
    assert sha_bytes(path.read_bytes()) == source["sha256"]
    document = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    race = document["race"]
    sim = Simulation.from_config(race["config"], race["seed"])
    used = 0
    for sample in race["samples"]:
        raw = sim.observation()
        assert sample["tick"] == sim.tick and sample["time"] == sim.elapsed
        assert all(raw[key] == sample[key] for key in ("kart", "progress", "control", "rescue"))
        if sim.tick == candidate["tick"]:
            break
        while used < len(race["commands"]) and race["commands"][used]["applied_tick"] == sim.tick + 1:
            sim.set_control(race["commands"][used]["action_id"])
            used += 1
        sim.step()
    assert sim.tick == candidate["tick"] and sim.tick not in source["sent_ticks"]
    assert sim.tick % GRID_TICKS == 0 and not sim.finished and not sim.reset_events
    state, motion = current_observation(sim)
    future = forecast(sim, retain_trace=True)
    assert future is not None
    assert list(preview_xy(state)) == candidate["preview_15m_xy_m"]
    assert future["minimum_future_center_clearance_m"] == candidate["future_minimum_clearance_m"]
    if candidate["risk_class"] == "hazard":
        assert all(("left" if row["offset"] > 0 else "right") == candidate["edge_side"]
                   for row in future["trace"] if not row["on_road"])
    nearest = min(source["sent_ticks"], key=lambda tick: (abs(tick - sim.tick), tick))
    internal = {key: copy.deepcopy(value) for key, value in vars(sim).items() if key not in {"track", "handling"}}
    return {
        "id": f"natural-{pair_index:02d}-{candidate['risk_class']}", "matched_pair_index": pair_index,
        "region": candidate["region"], "risk_class": candidate["risk_class"], "edge_side": candidate["edge_side"],
        "expected": "leaves_road" if candidate["risk_class"] == "hazard" else "stays_on_road",
        "observation": state, "road_frame_motion": motion,
        "proof": {
            "setup": SETUP, "course": "stadium", "source_path": source["path"],
            "source_sha256": source["sha256"], "source_seed": race["seed"],
            "baseline_navigation": {key: copy.deepcopy(value) for key, value in state.items()
                                    if key != "current_road_frame"},
            "source_sample": copy.deepcopy(sample), "source_sample_index": race["samples"].index(sample),
            "history_boundary": {"tick": sim.tick, "commands_consumed": used,
                                 "prefix_commands_sha256": json_sha(race["commands"][:used]),
                                 "last_applied_tick": race["commands"][used - 1]["applied_tick"] if used else None,
                                 "next_applied_tick": race["commands"][used]["applied_tick"] if used < len(race["commands"]) else None,
                                 "nearest_sent_observation_tick": nearest, "nearest_sent_tick_distance": abs(nearest - sim.tick),
                                 "selected_tick_was_never_submitted": True},
            "initial_internal_state": internal, "held_control": sim.action_id,
            "projected_road_m": sim.s, "projected_offset_m": sim.offset,
            "current_curvature_rad_m": sim.track.at(sim.s)[3],
            "preview_15m_xy_m": list(preview_xy(state)),
            "body_slip_deg": math.degrees(wrap(math.atan2(sim.vy, sim.vx) - sim.heading)),
            "selection_candidate": candidate, "forecast": future,
            "future_scope": "Hypothetical held-current-input continuation; recorded future commands are ignored",
        },
    }


def validate(cases, excluded_xy):
    assert len(cases) == 16 and len({case["id"] for case in cases}) == 16
    assert len({case["proof"]["source_path"] for case in cases}) == 16
    xy = [preview_xy(case["observation"]) for case in cases]
    assert len(set(xy)) == 16 and not set(xy) & excluded_xy
    cells = Counter((case["region"], case["risk_class"], case["edge_side"]) for case in cases)
    assert len(cells) == 8 and set(cells.values()) == {2}
    controls = {}
    for region in ("straight", "curve"):
        risk_controls = {risk: Counter(case["proof"]["held_control"] for case in cases
                                       if case["region"] == region and case["risk_class"] == risk)
                         for risk in ("safe", "hazard")}
        assert risk_controls["safe"] == risk_controls["hazard"]
        controls[region] = {risk: dict(sorted(values.items())) for risk, values in risk_controls.items()}
    for case in cases:
        proof = case["proof"]
        sim = Simulation(**SETUP, seed=proof["source_seed"])
        for key, value in proof["initial_internal_state"].items():
            setattr(sim, key, copy.deepcopy(value))
        state, motion = current_observation(sim)
        assert state == case["observation"] and motion == case["road_frame_motion"]
        assert proof["baseline_navigation"] == {key: value for key, value in state.items()
                                                if key != "current_road_frame"}
        assert forecast(sim, retain_trace=True) == proof["forecast"]
        assert state["finished"] is False and state["road"]["on_road"]
        assert sim.speed >= MINIMUM_SPEED_M_S and not sim.reset_events
        assert proof["forecast"]["initial_center_clearance_m"] >= MINIMUM_MARGIN_M
        assert proof["forecast"]["initial_center_clearance_m"] <= MAXIMUM_CURRENT_CLEARANCE_M
        minimum = proof["forecast"]["minimum_future_center_clearance_m"]
        assert minimum >= MINIMUM_MARGIN_M if case["risk_class"] == "safe" else minimum <= -MINIMUM_MARGIN_M
    return {"cases": 16, "distinct_source_races": 16, "matched_safe_hazard_pairs": 8,
            "region_risk_edge": {f"{a}_{b}_{c}": n for (a, b, c), n in sorted(cells.items())},
            "held_inputs_by_region_and_risk": controls, "unique_fresh_15m_xy_pairs": 16,
            "source_seeds": sorted({case["proof"]["source_seed"] for case in cases}),
            "minimum_current_clearance_m": min(case["proof"]["forecast"]["initial_center_clearance_m"] for case in cases),
            "current_clearance_ranges_by_risk": {
                risk: [min(case["proof"]["forecast"]["initial_center_clearance_m"] for case in cases if case["risk_class"] == risk),
                       max(case["proof"]["forecast"]["initial_center_clearance_m"] for case in cases if case["risk_class"] == risk)]
                for risk in ("safe", "hazard")},
            "minimum_safe_future_clearance_m": min(case["proof"]["forecast"]["minimum_future_center_clearance_m"] for case in cases if case["risk_class"] == "safe"),
            "maximum_hazard_future_clearance_m": max(case["proof"]["forecast"]["minimum_future_center_clearance_m"] for case in cases if case["risk_class"] == "hazard"),
            "maximum_absolute_body_slip_deg": max(abs(case["proof"]["body_slip_deg"]) for case in cases),
            "speed_range_m_s": [min(case["proof"]["selection_candidate"]["speed_m_s"] for case in cases),
                                max(case["proof"]["selection_candidate"]["speed_m_s"] for case in cases)],
            "cases_at_12_m_s_within_1e_minus9_tolerance": sum(
                abs(case["proof"]["selection_candidate"]["speed_m_s"] - 12) < 1e-9 for case in cases),
            "all_before_first_rescue": True, "all_selected_ticks_unsent": True,
            "all_original_sent_15m_xy_excluded": True, "exact_reconstruction_and_forecast": True}


def main():
    assert fingerprint() == SOURCE_FINGERPRINT
    sources, excluded_xy, freshness = source_pool()
    candidates, scan = scan_candidates(sources, excluded_xy)
    scan["candidate_cells"] = {
        f"{region}_{risk}_{edge}": {"ticks": len(values), "source_races": len({value["source_path"] for value in values})}
        for (region, risk, edge), values in sorted(group_candidates(candidates).items())
    }
    print(json.dumps({"candidate_scan": scan}, indent=2), flush=True)
    selected = select_candidates(candidates)
    within_edge_feasible = selected is not None
    if selected is None:
        print("Stronger within-edge matched pairing infeasible; checking within-region matching with unchanged edge quotas.", flush=True)
        selected = select_candidates(candidates, match_edge=False)
    assert selected is not None, "No 16-race within-region matched bank found; do not relax silently"
    source_by_path = {source["path"]: source for source in sources}
    cases = [reconstruct_case(candidate, source_by_path[candidate["source_path"]], index)
             for index, pair in enumerate(selected) for candidate in pair]
    coverage = validate(cases, excluded_xy)
    assert fingerprint() == SOURCE_FINGERPRINT
    bank = {"schema_version": 1, "metadata": {
        "scope": "Natural recorded-prefix states; hypothetical 30-frame held-current-input forecasts",
        "source_fingerprint": SOURCE_FINGERPRINT, "setup": SETUP, "forecast_steps": FORECAST_STEPS,
        "dt": DT, "horizon_s": FORECAST_STEPS * DT, "grid_ticks": GRID_TICKS,
        "minimum_current_and_future_margin_m": MINIMUM_MARGIN_M, "minimum_speed_m_s": MINIMUM_SPEED_M_S,
        "maximum_current_clearance_m": MAXIMUM_CURRENT_CLEARANCE_M,
        "road_frame_units": ROAD_FRAME_UNITS, "edge_definition": "sign of current road-centre offset",
        "region_definition": "initial absolute centreline curvature <=0.0001 rad/m is straight; otherwise curve",
        "selection_algorithm": select_candidates.__doc__, "source_manifest": sources,
        "matching": {"complete_native_input_frequencies_exact_within_region": True,
                     "complete_native_input_frequencies_exact_within_edge": within_edge_feasible,
                     "stronger_within_edge_design_feasible": within_edge_feasible,
                     "risk_region_edge_quotas_unchanged": True, "distinct_races_required": 16},
        "selection_feasibility_findings": [
            {"attempt": "stronger_within_edge_pair_matching", "solution_found": within_edge_feasible,
             "scope": "Exact search over the registered deterministic hazard representatives and safe partners"},
            {"attempt": "requested_within_region_pair_matching", "solution_found": True,
             "all_requested_constraints_preserved": True,
             "common_current_clearance_0.5_to_3m": True,
             "optional_all_historical_sent_15m_xy_exclusion_preserved": True}],
        "source_manifest_sha256": json_sha(sources), "prior_bank_manifest": freshness,
        "excluded_demonstration_xy_m": DEMONSTRATION_XY_M, "excluded_15m_xy_count": len(excluded_xy),
        "candidate_scan": scan, "candidate_pool_sha256": json_sha(candidates),
        "coverage": coverage, "model_calls": 0, "native_input_search": False,
        "current_states_perturbed_or_reflected": False,
        "recorded_future_commands_used_for_forecast": False,
        "limitations": ["Small stratified capability screen, not natural deployment prevalence or independent random sampling.",
                        "One snapshot per source race avoids duplicate departure episodes; shared initial seeds still correlate trials.",
                        "Held-input forecasting does not identify optimal controls or establish improved driving.",
                        "Factual handling fields do not give the model the complete simulator update equations."]},
        "cases": cases}
    output = ROOT / "cases.json"
    assert not output.exists(), "Refuse to overwrite a retained bank; review an explicit replacement first"
    output.write_text(json.dumps(bank, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(coverage, indent=2, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

limitations: Small stratified capability screen, not natural deployment prevalence or independent random sampling.
One snapshot per source race avoids duplicate departure episodes; shared initial seeds still correlate trials.
Held-input forecasting does not identify optimal controls or establish improved driving.
Factual handling fields do not give the model the complete simulator update equations.

metadata.road_frame_units: Angles are degrees and velocities are m/s in the CURRENT ROAD frame. Positive nose_vs_road_deg and velocity_vs_road_deg mean LEFT of the current road tangent. Positive velocity_left_m_s means LEFT; positive velocity_forward_m_s means FORWARD along that tangent.
metadata.scope: Natural recorded-prefix states; hypothetical 30-frame held-current-input forecasts
metadata.selection_algorithm:
Pair each hazard with a distinct-race safe state of the same region/input.

Candidate hazard representatives maximize the smaller physical safety margin
within each race/region/edge/input stratum, breaking ties by earliest tick.
Each possible safe partner minimizes current-clearance difference, then
speed difference, then tick within its race. Deterministic backtracking
supplies two hazards and two safe states in every region/edge stratum with
globally distinct races and 15 m coordinates. First require matching the
partners' physical edge too. If that stronger design is infeasible, an
explicitly recorded second attempt permits opposite-edge partners while
retaining all physical-edge quotas and exact input matching within region.
A new held input in the current region is tried first;
this is a deterministic ordering preference, not an optimal diversity claim.

next_gate.crossing_rule: Next gate only: step crosses plane<=0 to>0 and interpolated |lateral|<=half_width. Plane positive=gate forward side; lateral positive=gate left. Bearing points to centre; forward heading orients gate. Within_span_now is not credit. Uncredited gate remains required; reverse crossings and rescue give no credit.

observation.units: m,s; display angles deg, handling angles rad. Positive steering/yaw/curvature/ego y/offset are LEFT; ego x forward. Preview distances are centreline arc from nearest projection. Edge clearance<0 is outside. Need=v²×|curvature|; grip ratio>1 exceeds current surface grip. Grip radius excludes steering limits/transients.
